paragraphs: Persuasive advertisements, despite the irrefutable benefits, entail largely inevitable drawbacks. So, there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Admittedly, one might argue that advertising bring undeniable economic benefit. First, because advertising content with appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand and spending power, production are increase. Then, it makes more employment opportunities and greater state revenue through taxation. For example, e-commerce platforms like Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam have rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Additionally, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, so advertising makes it an important driver of economic activity.

On this side of the debate, people also cite that advertising has negative social consequences. Advertisements are regularly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions and this make foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook and this lead to frustration when they cannot afford them. So that, advertising promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, I think I agree at both views, it is valid to some certain extent, and advertising contribute to social dissatisfaction, also it play a crucial role in economic development.
review.overall: Em đã hoàn thành đủ bốn phần và có ví dụ Shopee/Lazada đúng hướng. Tuy nhiên, em dùng one might argue không đúng chức năng ở câu chủ đề, dùng so và because trái quy tắc lớp, đồng thời lặp nhiều lỗi hòa hợp chủ ngữ–động từ. Conclusion có quan điểm nhưng đang nối câu chắp vá; em cần viết lại và tự soát nghiêm túc.

paragraphs: Persuasive advertising can bring substantial economic benefits, despite the social drawbacks it may also create. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. First, creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand and spending power, causing production to increase. This creates more employment opportunities and greater state revenue through taxation, which strengthens the economy. For example, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting both their sales and the wider digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising creates direct jobs in marketing, media and design, thereby making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Advertisements regularly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards and luxury possessions, which may foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok and Facebook. When they cannot afford these products, they may experience frustration. Consequently, repeated exposure to such messages can promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, both views have merit: advertising contributes to employment and economic development, while its idealised messages may also increase social dissatisfaction.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that news reporting exerts an excessive influence on people’s daily lives and that this trend is harmful. Personally, I acknowledge this strong influence, although I believe its effects are not entirely negative.

Admittedly, news media have a considerable influence on people’s lives today. In society today, the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet allows people to follow the news instantly wherever and whenever they are; consequently, news has become a regular part of their routine. Moreover, intense competition among news outlets also increases the influence of news. In order to gain attention, most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and then present it in a highly sensationalized manner. Besides, the news has dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals; therefore, this presentation reinforces the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, the news media have harmful effects, although they can also bring considerable benefits to people. Exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news can overwhelm people and make them feel overly anxious and helpless, even in situations that do not directly affect them. Although I acknowledge these harmful effects, news coverage also warns the public to existing and looming problems in society, such as crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. Individuals are better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats. As a result, these individuals can handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, although I acknowledge that news media have a considerable influence on people’s lives, I am convinced that this is not an entirely negative development.

paragraphs: Some people argue that school should reward students who have the best academic result. Many others have a different opinion that should reward students who have improvements. Personally, I am to advocate the both view.

Admittedly, rewarding school reward student who have the best academic result is the true opinion. Students have diligently applied themselves to their studies and they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards and they propel towards overall academic gains. Besides that, this opinion is the same as the kind of competition, they seem in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. And so, students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition. So, they enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, they also should reward students who have improvements. If only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, it causes others to think that their effort is futile. Because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals, students are prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, which obviously makes gradually lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, this method also can makes emphasizing improvements. Because, it encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and helps students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, and thus, they are irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. In this mean, the constant desire to outdo themselves and even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I argue that both view are successful, each view are bring some benefits for students and I agree both views.

paragraphs: Some people argue that schools should reward students who have the best academic results. Others believe that schools should also reward students who show improvement. Personally, I advocate rewarding both groups.

Admittedly, rewarding students with the best academic results is justified. First, they have diligently applied themselves to their studies and deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, potentially improving overall academic results. Besides that, this kind of competition is seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. As a result, students become used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which may enable them to achieve success later in life.

However, schools should also reward students who show improvement. To begin with, if only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, this may cause other students to think that their effort is futile. This is because they may feel unable to surpass those outstanding individuals, making them prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and causing them to gradually lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, emphasizing improvements can also help students. This approach encourages all students to be diligent in their studies and helps them understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. In this way, the constant desire to outdo themselves can even benefit them more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I believe schools should reward both students with the best results and those who show improvement.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: In some countries, parents are choosing to teach children themselves at home instead of sending them to school. Although such development is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that the disadvantages that it offers are far more pronounced.

Admittedly, homeschooling brings some benefits for parents. Some parents use homeschooling method argue that this method allow parents to save money, since no school fees are required. And at home, educated children are less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure both that cause emotional and mental problems. Furthermore, parents teaching their children at home by themselves, they can tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones, moreover, its often not the case in traditional schooling because of the large class size.

However, I believe that the substantial detriments of this development far outweigh the positive and these view are sound suitable, its also harmful. This educational approach don't actually save money, moreover, parents need to pay a large amount of money for lab equipment and tutors, and if one parent needs to be cut off, its cater for their child's needs, be these academic or personal. Furthermore, most parents are not well versed in all school subjects, its cause some difficulties in properly explaining concepts for children and ultimately academic problems. Finally, even social problems that children have to faced with at school, as bullying and having romantic feeling for others, they need to prepare them for social and workplace situations in the future.

In conclusion, although it is true that homeschooling method may bring about a few advantages, there are relatively minor and should not overshadow the far more significant and long-lasting drawbacks it entails.

paragraphs: In certain countries, families are opting to educate their children at home rather than send them to school. Although such a development is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that the disadvantages that it offers are far more pronounced.

Admittedly, supporters of homeschooling argue that it brings some benefits for parents. First, it may allow some parents to save money as they do not have to pay school fees. Second, children educated at home are less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure, both of which can cause emotional and mental problems. Furthermore, parents who teach their children at home can tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones. This is often not the case in traditional schooling due to large class sizes.

However, I believe that the substantial detriments of this development far outweigh its benefits. First, this educational approach may not actually save money as parents may have to pay for laboratory equipment and tutors; one parent may also reduce paid work to meet their child's needs. Furthermore, most parents are not well versed in all school subjects. This can cause difficulties in properly explaining concepts to children and ultimately lead to academic problems. Finally, even social problems that children face at school, such as bullying and having romantic feelings for others, can help prepare them for social and workplace situations in the future.

In conclusion, although it is true that homeschooling may bring about a few advantages, these are relatively minor and should not overshadow the far more significant and long-lasting drawbacks it entails.
